@MvPolynomial.degreeOf_eq_natDegree : ∀ {R : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ]
  (a : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ R),
  MvPolynomial.degreeOf a p =
    ((MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R { b // b ≠ a })
        ((MvPolynomial.rename ⇑(Equiv.optionSubtypeNe a).symm) p)).natDegree

MvPolynomial.natDegree_optionEquivLeft : ∀ (R : Type u_1) {σ : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R]
  (p : MvPolynomial (Option σ) R), ((MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R σ) p).natDegree = MvPolynomial.degreeOf none p

@MvPolynomial.degreeOf_eq_sup : ∀ {R : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (n : σ) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  MvPolynomial.degreeOf n f = f.support.sup fun m ↦ m n

@Polynomial.supDegree_eq_natDegree : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R),
  AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree id p.toFinsupp = p.natDegree
